It is a terrestrial orchid that belongs to the Orchidaceae family, known for its unique and vibrant flowers. The health benefits of Arachnorchis huegelii include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing stress and promoting relaxation.
